newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche says DMG build-up not over yet.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche says DMG build-up not over yet.

text.p: Germany's Deutsche Bank AG said on Wednesday that the build-up phase for its London-based investment banking unit Deutsche Morgan Grenfell was not over yet.

"Deutsche Morgan Grenfell has not yet reached the end of its build-up phase, but future expension will continue to be monitored and focused," Deutsche said in its annual report which was released on Wednesday.

"Although we have begun to challenge a number of our international competitors in their home markets, we still need to build up our activities in Europe ... and in Asia where we have not yet matched the penetration of other group divisions of Deutsche Bank," the report added.
DMG would also continue "selective development of its capabilities in North America."

In a separate statement, the bank also said precautions it took related to damages at Morgan Grenfell Asset Management were reflected in a 1.2 billion marks ($712.2 million) increase in extraordinary expenses in 1996.
